name: @repo/context-sync
description: Context mirror sync algorithm for the OuterLayer context layer: resolves a git ref, classifies the .outerlayer/ tree via @repo/context-core, and mirrors it through a narrow db port (ContextMirrorPort) and git port (GitPort). No Supabase, no direct git client — the concrete ports are supplied by the caller (dashboard). Self-records every sync attempt to the context_sync_event ledger through the db port.
